text.tspan: Mineral processing involves the extraction, purification, or production of materials from ores, brines, or other
raw sources, often as a byproduct or through specialized industrial processes.

tspan.tspan: USGS – Mineral Commodity Summaries (2026); USGS – Historical Statistics for Mineral and Material Commodities (2024); BGS –
The sum of all countries may exceed World data on certain years, due to discrepancies between data sources.
